style: deep oceanic watercolor and oil with bioluminescent teal scrolls, coral arches, and sunken marble
rules: Each item belongs to a unified tabletop cosmetic collection sharing the exact same palette, brushwork, and motif. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or borders.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Sunken Library

items.subject: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Sunken Library. A wide 16:9 tabletop playmat with a calm, low-contrast textured center so playing cards read crisply over it, and painterly theme accents along the outer edges.
a painterly fantasy portrait bust of Tide Scholar in the theme of Sunken Library. A centered bust portrait medallion subject with dramatic workshop lighting and clean silhouette.

an adorable small magical tabletop companion creature, Reef Octopus, matching Sunken Library. A charming tabletop companion creature in full-body view centered with breathing room around it on a deep moody background.
a circular ornamental portrait frame medallion titled Coral Filigree in the style of Sunken Library. An ornate circular portrait border motif with clean dark interior so an avatar sits inside it.

an ornate vertical Command-Zone card border frame titled Abyssal Command matching Sunken Library. An ornate vertical rectangular border frame for a commander card slot with a calm dark interior center.

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
